card.fact_statement: 2024 YR4 could be related to the near-Earth asteroid 2017 UW5, which has a similar orbit.
card.source_span: Astronomers Carlos and Raúl de la Fuente Marcos have proposed that 2024 YR4 could be related to a group of near-Earth asteroids on similar orbits that also have virtual impactors: 2017 UW5, 2018 GG4, 2019 SC, and 2020 MQ61.
